Frequently Asked Questions
Location and Accessibility
1. Where is NITS located ?
Ans. NITS is located in a sprawling self-contained campus at A 20&21, Institutional Area, Sector 62, NOIDA, Uttar Pradesh, PIN – 201309. It is behind the Ericsson building in sector 62.
2. How to reach NITS from Railway station/ Airport or by Metro/ Taxi ?
Ans. NITS is well connected from New Delhi Airport & various Railway Stations of Delhi and is about 5 km from Delhi-UP border. The nearest metro station is Noida Electronic City. 

Please search NITS on Google Map App for location drive directions
3. What are the working days/ hours ?
Ans. Training programmes are generally held during Monday to Friday. However, depending upon needs these may be held/continued on Saturdays/Sundays as well.  Normal working hours are from 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM
Training Programmes
1.What is the procedure for applying for a training programme ?
Ans.  One can apply for the training programme by registering on our online portal.
2. Does NITS accept direct applications from individuals ?
Ans. 
                       Direct applications from individuals are also entertained for most of the 'On-Campus Programmes'. However, for specialized training programmes  like Trainings for Technical Committee Members etc. nominations are to be duly routed through Policy Research and Training Deptt. at BIS HQ.
3. 
                         Can I propose for a training programme for topic of my choice ?
4. Can I propose for a training programme at location of my choice ?
Ans.  Yes, the custom made training programme can be organised at any location.
5. Can any Off-campus training program be organized outside India?
Ans. Yes, however for detailed procedure and fee structure etc  please mail your query at nits@bis.gov.in
6. I am foreign national. Can I attend any of your programme.  If so, what is procedure & formalities to be completed ?
Ans. Yes,  foreign nationals can attend any of the training programmes offered by NITS. However, you are required to provide us the passport details well in advance (approx. 2 months) to seek political clearance from Govt. of India.
7. Whether NITS conducts online programmes ?
Ans. Yes, NITS conducts online training programme.
8. How the Online program is organized ?
9. Any specific requirements for attending the Online training program ?

Fee structure
1. What is the fee-structure for participation of different training programmes ?
Ans.  The detailed fee structure can be accessed athttps://bis.gov.in/index.php/training-2/training-fee/
2. What payment forms and methods do you accept ?
Ans.  Payment can be made online using the bank gateway when asked while registering in the training portal for acquiring training.  

In exceptional cases Payment can be made  by NEFT. Our bank details are as under :
Bureau of Indian Standards, Savings A/c No. 712210100000650, Bank of India,Sec-62 Noida, Branch Code 7122, IFSC Code BKID0007122. ## NITS GST No. 09AAATB0431G2Z8, SAC Code: 999294
3. What is your refund / cancellation policy? ?
Ans.  The details of Refund of Training & Hostel Fees can be accessed athttps://bis.gov.in/index.php/training-2/training-fee/
4. Do you offer discounts ?
Ans.  The details of discounts offered can be accessed athttps://bis.gov.in/index.php/training-2/training-fee/
5. How can I check the status of my booking ?
Ans.   Email will be sent to you after the nomination has been confirmed and same can be checked in your registered account.
6. In case, I as nominated participant am unable to attend the training on the stipulated dates, can another colleague/participant from my organization be substituted in my place ?
Ans. Yes, in the exceptional case, please send the request at least 24 hours before the start of the course.
7. Can I claim refund if I am unable to attend the training programme ?
Ans. Yes, please refer the payment policy for the same.
8. Can I change the date of my course once I have booked it ?
Ans. Yes, in exceptional circumstances.  However, same is not guaranteed.
9. Is accommodation included in the course fee ?
Ans.  No.
Hostel
1. Whether Hostel Facility is available ?
Ans. NITS provides residential facilities to participants in its Hostel which has 48 spacious air-conditioned well furnished rooms with television and hot-cold water supply in each room, laundry and dining facilities. Hostel also provides post training hour recreational facilities such as table tennis, badminton, volley ball, carom, chess.
2. What are the charges levied for hostel ?
Ans. Room rent (single occupancy): Rs. 2000/- per day; Twin sharing basis: Rs. 1500/- per head per day; Applicable GST@ 18% on Hostel fee. Charges for Breakfast & Dinner are included in room rent.
3. How can one book hostel facilities ?
Ans. You may register for the program, the hostel may be booked from there itself.  
While filling the nomination form given athttp://www.bis.org.in/trg/NominationForm.pdf, do mention if the hostel facility is to be availed. Please fill in the details of course fee, payment made through NEFT/ DD details, including that for the hostel charges, if applicable. 

Alternately, The hostel booking form is available online athttps://bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/Hostel_Proforma.pdfcan be filled up and emailed tonits@bis.gov.inornits@bis.gov.in. For sending by post, hard copy may be addressed to: Head, National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS), Bureau of Indian Standards, A – 20 & 21, Institutional Area, Sector – 62, NOIDA - 201309, U.P.
Logistics
1. Is there any pre-course reading ?
Ans.  No, You will be given all the course materials only when you arrive at the venue.
2. What course material will be provided ?
Ans. You will receive a folder containing most of the slides presented during the course. This will include key references for the future.
3. What do we need to bring to the course ?
Ans.   Just bring yourself! You will be provided with a pen/pencil, course manual and paper. If you would like to bring your own notebook, laptop and pen – that's entirely up to you.
4. Are meals provided ?
Ans. The course will include morning and afternoon tea/coffee and lunch on each day.
5. Whether there is crèche facility ?
Ans. No, there is no creche facility at NITS or any other location of training centres.
6. How many people typically attend the course ?
Ans. The number of people who attend the training varies but most of our courses attract around 20 people.
7. Is there any dress code ?
Ans. We suggest formal attire, as permitted in government institutions, according to the weather.
8. Will I get a certificate of attendance?
Ans.  Yes. all our course attendees will receive a 'Certificate of Attendance' which can be used towards your continuing professional development.
Feedback
1. Do you provide any post-training support?
Ans. No, No post training support is provided.
2. How can I provide my feedback ?
Ans. The feedback is collected at the end of the training programme by the course coordinator. 
    The feedback form is also available online athttps://bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/feedback_form.pdfand can be filled up and emailed tonits@bis.gov.inornits@bis.gov.in. For sending by post, hard copy may be addressed to: Head , National Institute of Training for Standardization (NITS), Bureau of Indian Standards, A – 20 & 21, Institutional Area, Sector – 62, NOIDA - 201309, U.P.
